description: This file contains shell script functions for upgrading eMMC storage in embedded devices, including functions for handling tar and fit upgrade files, copying configurations, and performing the upgrade process.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Handles upgrade process using tar archive, including locating kernel and root filesystem, and writing data to eMMC device nodes.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Handles upgrade process using a fit image, setting up kernel blocks accordingly.

methods.name: emmc_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to appropriate eMMC partitions.

methods.name: emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function that determines file type and calls specific upgrade function.
